description.en: Hungary is a landlocked country in Central Europe. Spanning much of the Carpathian Basin, it is bordered by Slovakia to the north, Ukraine to the northeast, Romania to the east and southeast, Serbia to the south, Croatia and Slovenia to the southwest, and Austria to the west.
description.zh-CN: 匈牙利是位於歐洲的内陆国家。根據地理分區的不同定義，匈牙利被認為處在中歐和東歐。
description.zh-TW: 匈牙利是位於歐洲的內陸國家。根據地理分區的不同定義，匈牙利被認為處在中歐和東歐。
